input.quote: 14.5 Limitation of Liability. NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER FOR ANY SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR LOST PROFITS ARISING FROM OR RELATING TO ANY BREACH OF THIS AGREEMENT, REGARDLESS OF ANY NOTICE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
input.rationale: Section 14.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision in the Agreement (searches for "aggregate liability" and "shall not exceed" return nothing else, and Section 14.6 confirms insurance does not create any liability limit). It provides a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential/punitive damages and mutual carve-outs for indemnification (Sections 14.1/14.2), confidentiality (Article XI) and IP (Article X) — but there is no aggregate monetary cap of any kind, so each party's direct-damages exposure is unlimited. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap of 12 months' fees with carve-outs; the waiver and carve-outs alone do not satisfy the material cap term. The exposure is symmetric rather than one-sided (not walk-away territory), so we make the minimal edit: insert a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' payments made by Sanofi and USD 1,000,000, preserving the existing carve-outs, adding gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud, and confirming Sanofi's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes. The existing final sentence is left intact so indemnities and confidentiality/IP claims remain outside the cap.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap to Section 14.5, with indemnification, confidentiality, IP, gross negligence/willful misconduct/fraud and Sanofi's payment obligations outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 waives indirect damages but contains no aggregate cap, so both parties' direct-damages exposure is unlimited; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality and IP obligations, gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud sit outside the cap, and Sanofi's payment obligations are not treated as damages.

ops.oldText: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY SANOFI UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, ITS BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD; SANOFI'S PAYMENT OBLIGATIONS UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES FOR PURPOSES OF THIS SECTION 14.5. NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5
